notes: MC cores: MiSTer Control's own build of the NES core (MC-NES) installs from Settings > Install next to the stock one and reports the game's memory, registers and controller state to the app every frame. The game sheet gets Play on MC-NES and a Live section (world, lives, score, timer and more from a RAM map; CPU state; pad polls; RAM coverage), the Home screen shows the live line under the title, Settings > Cores shows the telemetry health. RAM map shipped for Super Mario Bros., checked against the TV. Also: launch_rom takes core=mc; /api/mc, /api/mc/snapshot, /api/mc/ram.
